About

School software and ID cards, made to fit.

Simpedu builds school management software and prints custom ID cards. Both are designed around how institutions actually work, not the other way round.

What we do

Two crafts, one institution.

School management software

Student records, attendance, fees, grades, and communications in one place, with admin workflows for the front office. Teachers, staff, and administrators each get a view that matches their day.

Custom ID-card printing

Durable PVC cards with your institution's identity, printed and finished to a professional standard. Sample designs shown; every card is made to order.

How we work

From first call to first school day.

The work starts with a conversation about your workflows: admissions, attendance, fees, and communications. We import your records, build your fee structures, and approve ID-card artwork with you before anything goes live. Then we train your team role by role, on the workflows they will actually use. After launch, support is available Monday to Friday, 9AM to 6PM IST.
